_description: Fired when a visitor clicks a link to a downloadable file
_note: Fired automatically by the client script when enableAutoLinkTracking is on, and takes precedence over outbound_link_click when a link is both — a link to another site's PDF is recorded as a download, since downloading the file is what the visitor actually did.
file_extension_description: Lowercase extension without the dot. Empty string when the link carries a download attribute but the URL has no extension to read
link_text_description: Visible text of the clicked link, whitespace-collapsed and truncated. Empty string for a link containing only an image or icon
